packs.title: Borders on old maps
packs.summary: Europe on eight dated maps, drawn on the globe. Tap a country and drag the date: the map changes, and the last map's outline stays, dashed.

packs.title: Fires across the sea
packs.summary: A pyre on every peak of the Aegean. Touch one: every peak that can see it lights its own, and the fire runs from island to island, as the news of Troy reached Argos in a night.

packs.title: A gathering of water
packs.summary: The rivers of South America on the globe: touch one to follow its water to the coast and see the tributaries that gather into it.

packs.title: A gathering of water, alive
packs.summary: South America's rivers with the water running: touch one, or rest a finger and draw across many, and the light runs to the sea together.

packs.title: Delivery check
packs.summary: A test pack: which revision arrived, and from where. Tap the sea for a ring.

packs.title: The herds
packs.summary: The camel family's history as small herds you follow across the globe: from North America, camels north to Asia, llamas south to the Andes.

packs.title: The lead line
packs.summary: HMS Challenger sails her whole way round the world, 1872–76, as the date plays. Touch the sea anywhere: a lead runs out until it finds the floor. Drag the glass to see the floor under it.

packs.title: When the sea was low
packs.summary: Touch the sea and it goes out: the shelves come up as the dry land they were when the ice was greatest, Britain joined to Europe, Asia to America, with rivers across them and mammoths walking.

packs.title: The monsoon's sails
packs.summary: Dhows cross the Indian Ocean the way they did for two thousand years: out with the summer wind, home with the winter's. Drag the year, or touch a port to send its ships out.

packs.title: The sea between
packs.summary: An engraved chart of the Aegean lying on the globe: sound the sea between the islands, and read its notes on the wind, a caldera, a palm and the deep.

packs.title: Whales in the desert
packs.summary: Wadi Al-Hitan, Egypt: bones in the sand. Touch the sand and the sea that was here comes back, with the whales that swam in it.

packs.title: Sounding the deep
packs.summary: HMS Challenger exploring the deep ocean, 1873–76, station by station on the globe. Touch a station to lower the line to the recorded depth.

packs.title: The vine's long walk
packs.summary: საქართველო. One vine, eight thousand years long: it rises from a qvevri in the Georgian valley where the oldest wine was made and grows across the world as the years play.
